verdict.rationale: llamafile documents an HTTP server and API ('HTTP server, API, Web UI... options'), but the evidence pack never mentions official Python, JavaScript, or other client libraries. A raw HTTP API is only a developer building block, and the community mention of a separate llamaindex Python install is a third-party, user-side setup, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call the runtime from official client libraries in languages like Python or JavaScript
